novelty_flags.label: Bibliography / Sun2026 comparison
novelty_flags.one_line: The cited venue metadata says Journal of Econometrics 252, 106169, but the version of record is Journal of Econometrics 253, Article 106169; correct the bibliography before relying on this comparison.

soundness_flags.label: ass:full-contact
soundness_flags.one_line: The equality gamma(P)=0 is a proposal-specific all-cell contact restriction, not the standard condition named in HiranoPorter2009; retag it novel and justify the contact regime, or cite a source that states this exact condition.

soundness_flags.label: d_EKL, K_n, oeq:certified-gaussian-computation, and oeq:honest-policy-inference
soundness_flags.one_line: kl is declared only for a second argument in (0,1), while these discrepancies quantify over all A-valued rules, which may take 0 or 1; extend kl to [0,1]^2 with extended-real values or restrict and prove interior-valued rules.

soundness_flags.label: Eval, def:certificate-handle, and oeq:certified-gaussian-computation
soundness_flags.one_line: The certificate allows real-algebraic p,q but requires Eval to return a rational a in A; A cap Q^m can be empty for such inputs, so restrict this claim to rational p,q or change the output arithmetic model.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Econometrics version of record, 2026
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The record identifies Empirical welfare maximization with constraints as Journal of Econometrics 253, Article 106169, DOI 10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.106169, and describes uncertainty in estimated budget implementation costs.
The paper formulates a general welfare contrast g(x,theta) and develops local decision theory; it does not name or impose the proposal's gamma(P)=0 all-cell contact condition.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the reverse-KL discrepancy layer total: define extended-real KL on [0,1]^2, state which certified/minimax maps are interior, and use that convention consistently in d_EKL and K_n.

Split certificate arithmetic into a rational-registry theorem and an algebraic-registry theorem with algebraic output coordinates; do not claim rational feasible outputs for arbitrary real-algebraic capacity data.

Retag gamma(P)=0 as a novel local-contact regime, give an applied interpretation for common cell effects, and correct Sun2026 to Journal of Econometrics 253 while retaining the verified distinction from its estimated-budget problem.

Sharpen the eventual field contribution around the causal LAN lower bound plus an attaining exactly feasible learner, explicitly positioning the global face-gluing result as the new decision object required for that paired causal result.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two ill-posed certificate/discrepancy interfaces, repair the assumption and Sun bibliography characterization, then continue this field-tier angle to Stage 0.
